title: Cloud Drive: Secure Storage
summary: Secure cloud drive to store, sync, and access your photos & files on any device.
description:
Free up space instantly and keep your files accessible with Cloud Drive – the secure cloud storage solution with Auto Backup and App Lock security.

Cloud Drive allows you to store, manage, and sync your files across all devices. Featuring Instant File Preview, Automatic Sync, and a Secure App Lock, our app ensures your digital life is not only organized but fully protected from unauthorized access.

📂 Cloud Storage & Smart Preview
• Instant File Preview: View photos, videos, and PDFs without downloading
• Upload documents to your online drive instantly with one tap
• Organize files by folder, type, or date with professional file management
• Access your files anytime, anywhere—on your phone, tablet, or web

🔒 Advanced Security & App Lock
• Secure App Lock: Protect your private files with Fingerprint, PIN, or Pattern
• Private Vault: Create a secondary layer of safety for your most sensitive data
• Encrypted Cloud Storage: Industry-standard encryption for full user privacy
• Secure Access Control: Your data stays protected and visible only to you

🔄 Auto Backup & Real-Time Sync
• Automatic Photo Backup: Real-time gallery protection for your memories
• Auto-Sync Drive: Keep your files updated across your phone and computer
• Free up phone storage: Back up your data and clear space instantly
• Securely retrieve your data whenever you switch or upgrade devices

⚡ Fast, Reliable & Powerful
• High-speed cloud uploads and downloads for maximum efficiency
• Supports large files, 4K videos, and high-resolution media
• Web Access: Manage your files from any web browser safely
• All-in-one home for your PDFs, docs, images, and more

📱 Why Choose Cloud Drive?
• Free cloud storage to reclaim your phone’s memory
• Biometric Security: Use your phone’s lock to keep your storage private
• Smart Preview for quick browsing of 4K videos and photos
• Simple yet powerful cloud file manager for daily productivity

Cloud Drive is the perfect secure storage alternative for anyone who needs private space, automatic backup, and a secure vault in one app.

Download Cloud Drive today and keep your files safe and secure!
